# -methods rewrites method bodies, but go1.27.1 cannot compile them under
# GOEXPERIMENT=simd: the compiler crashes (golang/go#80657, fixed in later
# toolchains). This pins the crash so the README limitation stays accurate.
# When this script starts failing on a newer toolchain, the limitation is gone:
# update the README and turn this into a run-and-compare test.

loopvec -methods -split .
! stdout .
cmpenv stderr stderr.want
cmp ops_simd.go ops_simd.go.want

# The scalar build is unaffected.
exec go build .

# The simd build hits the internal compiler error.
env GOEXPERIMENT=simd
! exec go build .
! stdout .
stderr -count=1 '^# example\.com/test$'
stderr -count=1 '^\./ops_simd\.go:12:6: internal compiler error: missing Types entry: AddInt32s@simd0$'
stderr -count=1 '^Please file a bug report including a short program that triggers the error\.$'

-- go.mod --
module example.com/test

go 1.27.1
-- ops.go --
package test

type T struct{}

func (T) AddInt32s(dst, a, b []int32) {
	for i := range dst {
		dst[i] = a[i] + b[i]
	}
}
-- ops_simd.go.want --
//go:build goexperiment.simd

package test

import (
	"simd"
	"unsafe"
)

type T struct{}

func (T) AddInt32s(dst, a, b []int32) {
	if _loopvecOverlap(dst, a) || _loopvecOverlap(dst, b) {
		for i := range dst {
			dst[i] = a[i] + b[i]
		}
	} else {
		if len(dst) > 0 {
			_ = a[len(dst)-1]
			_ = b[len(dst)-1]
			for _i := 0; _i < len(dst); {
				_v1, _n := simd.LoadInt32sPart(a[_i:])
				_v2, _ := simd.LoadInt32sPart(b[_i:])
				_v1.Add(_v2).StorePart(dst[_i:])
				_i += _n
			}
		}
	}
}

func _loopvecOverlap[T any](a, b []T) bool {
	if len(a) == 0 || len(b) == 0 {
		return false
	}
	aStart := uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(unsafe.SliceData(a)))
	aEnd := aStart + uintptr(len(a))*unsafe.Sizeof(a[0])
	bStart := uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(unsafe.SliceData(b)))
	bEnd := bStart + uintptr(len(b))*unsafe.Sizeof(b[0])
	return aStart < bEnd && bStart < aEnd
}
-- stderr.want --
loopvec: rewrote 1 loop(s) in $WORK/ops.go
